name: Lighter Note Mesquite-Spiced Salmon Salad (Night 1)
whyItWorks: The salmon filet itself is omega-3-rich and tender; ordering it plain over white rice instead of salad greens makes it a 9/10 meal.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the salmon filet seasoned with salt only (no smoky mesquite chili rub) served with steamed jasmine rice or baked potato instead of the raw salad bed.
watchOuts: Mesquite spice rub if not ordered plain
Raw salad greens in standard Lighter Note presentation
